<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1182
Claimant:
Lisa Mcdaniel
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
1-12-24
Claim reported by the insured's representative, who advised that the policyholder's vehicle was sideswiped while
changing lanes and that the policyholder sustained a wrist fracture. The claim was opened and assigned for
investigation.
1-31-24
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the vehicle was covered at the time of loss. Requested the
police report and photographs from the scene.
2-5-24
Reviewed scene photographs, which confirm some details of the reported impact. No independent witnesses have
come forward, and the only accounts so far come from the parties involved.
3-4-24
Police records and statements from responding parties confirm the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene.
Vehicle damage appears consistent with the sideswipe described, with the damaged panels lining up with the other
vehicle's contact points.
3-6-24
Obtained the medical records for the claimant's wrist fracture. The injury is the type and severity expected from a
force of this kind, and the treatemnt followed a usual course.
3-18-24
Medical file shows the claimant's treatment tapered off steadily as recovery progressed. No prior injury to the same
wrist or arm appears in the records reviewed so far.
4-8-24
Spoke again with the claimant's representative, who confirmed the claimant's account of the lane change. The
claimant has described the events the same way in every conversation to date.
5-1-24
Our records show no earlier damage to the insured vehicle. A neighbor contacted us and believes the car was
already damaged a few weeks before the claimed date. This statement has not yet been verified and is being noted
for follow-up.
6-9-24
Requested the repair estimate and photographs of the vehicle from the repair facility to compare against the impact
described and the earlier damage concern raised by the neighbor.
6-12-24
Reviewed the neighbor's account alongside the vehicle records and photographs. The question of pre-existing
damage remains open pending further inquiry into the timing.
6-25-24
File remains open. Next steps are to obtain a recorded statement from the neighbor and confirm the repair history
before any settlement decision is made.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
